name: Hitonatsu no Yume
source:
Toshiki, the realist.
Mizuna, the girl he met on the roof.
And BROY, the school band whose members surround them.

It's the summer of their third year, and Toshiki must face not only the school festival, but also a promise that he may never be able to fulfill.

[From [url=http://www.grey-space.net/starchanchan/vn/projects-adreamofsummer.html]Deja Vu[/url]]
translation:
现实主义者俊树。
他在屋顶遇见的少女水菜。
以及围绕在两人身边的校园乐队BROY成员。

这是高中三年级的夏天。俊树不仅要面对学园祭，还要面对一个自己或许永远无法履行的约定。

[摘自[url=http://www.grey-space.net/starchanchan/vn/projects-adreamofsummer.html]Deja Vu[/url]]
